purpose: CodeClaw setting decision table. This file is a human-editable planning template and is not loaded by CodeClaw automatically.
howToUse: Set each status to keep_default, enable, disable, set_value, needs_secret, or not_used.
Fill value only when status is set_value or needs_secret.
For env settings, copy the final values to .env.local or export them in the shell.
For provider settings, apply the final values to ~/.codeclaw/providers.json and ~/.codeclaw/selection.json.
For MCP settings, apply the final values to ~/.codeclaw/mcp.json or <workspace>/.mcp.json.
Do not put real API keys, passwords, or tokens into this repository file.

statusLegend.needs_secret: Requires a secret value outside git.
statusLegend.not_used: Do not configure for this deployment.
